answer.answer: If your NUS exchange is an approved full-time course, you generally need a Student's Pass unless you hold an exempting immigration privilege. Submit the application while still in Vietnam, at least two months and no more than three months before the course begins. You do not need to be in Singapore while it is processed, and you cannot extend your stay while an application is processing. After approval, enter Singapore to complete the formalities for issuing the pass. The available evidence does not verify any Vietnam-specific additional steps.
whatToDo: Confirm that your NUS course is an approved full-time programme.
Check whether you already hold a valid Dependant's Pass, Long-Term Visit Pass, or Immigration Exemption Order; these may mean you do not need a Student's Pass.
Submit the Student's Pass application from Vietnam within the two-to-three-month window before your course starts.
After approval, enter Singapore and complete the formalities to issue the Student's Pass.
Use an accepted payment method for the fee: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Internet Direct Debit, or PayNow.
Check that any official Singapore website you use ends with .gov.sg.
whatToPrepare: A recent passport-sized digital colour photo taken within the last three months.
Any translations required for your application, properly attested or notarized by the issuing embassy, a notary public, or as specified by the evidence.
A payment method accepted for the Student's Pass fee.
Evidence of your NUS acceptance and course details, so you can confirm the course is full-time and approved.
warnings: The evidence does not provide the Student's Pass fee amount, processing time, arrival deadline, or a complete list of required documents.
If you change schools after approval but before collecting the pass, you must submit a new application.
If your existing immigration pass expires or is cancelled during your studies, you must apply for a Student's Pass to continue.
Part-time courses and courses conducted only in the evening or on weekends are not eligible for a Student's Pass.
The evidence does not verify Vietnam-specific entry or document requirements.
